checks.name: Layout review binds the original project, movie, receipt and witness bytes
Independent projection anchors agree with every expected shot-camera transform
Every projected planted contact has actual opaque matte support
All declared background regions follow the shot transform without unexplained plate drift

provenance.notes: Flat image-plane floor registration authored from existing 2D coordinates. The Google-summary screenshots supply direction, not CAD or measured camera calibration.

measurement_limits: Background prediction uses full-resolution frame-zero area averages against 128 × 72 RGB thumbnails: ten-design-pixel sampling, not full-resolution optical tracking.
Boot support uses 320 × 180 mattes: four-design-pixel sampling. Exact declared projection coordinates are separate from raster support.
This is an authored flat image-plane guide, not recovered metric scenery or game CAD. Perspective wireframes are guides, not generated animation.
This review binds the movie but does not repeat its full-resolution codec/audio audit, which remains separate.
Prop perspective, anatomy, acting, actual 3D occlusion and studio quality still need reference assets and human review.
